title: Computational Acoustics Simulator — Overview and definition
t: Computational Acoustics Simulator — Overview and definition
description: Predicts sound fields, noise, and vibration-acoustic coupling with wave solvers.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Predicts sound fields, noise, and vibration-acoustic coupling with wave solvers. A computational acoustics simulator solves the Helmholtz and wave equations with FEM, BEM, or ray methods to predict cabin noise, muffler performance, and sonar fields. Real implementations include Actran, VA One, and open tools like openCFS. It couples structural vibration to acoustic radiation and validates against microphone arrays.
capabilities: Ray tracing for high-frequency room and cabin acoustics
